desc: The recipe options turned off and on again mid-save, Paper Mario 64 linked (a player's report: with its recipes on, every recipe of the game's own gave a Mistake, and turning the options off did not bring them back). Three visits to Zess T. in one game: every option on, a Mushroom alone is the game's Shroom Fry; Paper Mario 64's, Paper Cut's and the Japanese release's recipes then turned off, a Fire Flower alone is the game's Spicy Soup; all turned on again, Rowf's Apple alone is Paper Mario's Super Soda at once. Never a Mistake (offscreen: the options are the settings page's, declared at start; the dish from each visit stays in the bag, so each next ingredient is given in the 300 frames Mario has between visits)
